texts.name: Vianne
texts.biography: Vianne refuses to talk about herself or her past and is angry when asked about it. Despite her secretive nature, she is a talented sorceress who can work well with others. She dreams of becoming a teacher so she can train dryads in the use of magic.

specialty.description: Increases the speed of Field and Sunny dryads by 1, and upon reaching level 4, also increases their attack and defense.
specialty.name: Field dryads
